final: WITH base AS (SELECT category, remaining, amount - spent AS diff FROM budget WHERE amount > 75), cat AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(diff) AS total FROM base GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM cat) SELECT cat.category, cat.avg_remaining, cat.total, cat.total - overall.avg_total AS above_avg FROM cat, overall WHERE overall.avg_total IS NOT NULL AND cat.total > overall.avg_total
